speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You have presented with progressive difficulty walking, urinary incontinence, and speech difficulties. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your handwriting, muscle stiffness, or tremors, particularly in your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old male. The patient has been experiencing a gradual difficulty in walking over the past 3 months, requiring wheelchair assistance for the last month. Additionally, there is a history of urinary incontinence for 1 year and recent onset of speech slurring making communication challenging.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is a strong possibility, but given the 1-year urinary history and 3-month gait decline, I must rule out Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus (NPH) and Spinal Cord Compression. We need MRI of the brain and spine immediately. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast, MRI Spine. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis.
